the convolutional neural net approach is the best of the three approaches we have investigated, that the SOM is the best of three methods we have investigated for dimensionality reduction, and that the convolutional network approach provides partial invarience to translation, scale, rotation, and deformation.
a hybrid neural network approach combining local image sampling, self-organizing map, and convolutional neural network can provide an accurate and robust face recognition system.
the convolutional neural networks are more accurate than MLPs and that the SOMs are more efficient than the Karhunne Loewe transforms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing methods for automatic face recognition from a single frontal image.
the development of a robust and reliable system for human face recognition, and the application of this system to the identification of individuals in a video sequence.
the problem of recognizing human faces from a database of images.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the convolutional neural networks are the best performing method, followed by the MLP, and the Karhunenko Loeve transform is the least performing method.
the convolutional neural net approach is the most effective and efficient method for face recognition.
the hybrid network is the most successful method for face recognition in the literature.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed method is able to achieve a 95.0 percent recognition rate, which is better than the 93.8 percent obtained by the Karhunne Loeve transform and MLP, and the 92.5 percent obtained by the SOM and MLP.

a convolutional neural networks can provide a good face recognition system, and that the combination of SOM and convolutional neural network can provide better results than the MLP and Karhunen-Loeve transform.

we have shown that it is possible to build a face recognition system that is capable of handling large variations in pose and facial details, and which is capable of handling new individuals without retraining the system.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a hybrid system of a convolutional neural net and a self-organizing map can be trained on a relatively small number of images and can be used to classify new images of faces that were not used for training.
the hybrid network provides a significant improvement over the SOM-MLP network.
a hybrid neural network can achieve good performance for face recognition.
